title:
Type containing valid search query operators, used to filter search results.
OperatorTypes fields map to a filterable field in {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}.

All operator usage follows this format:
'{Operator}:{Target}' or '{Operator}:"{Target}"'
Double quotes must be used to target values containing spaces.

Operator expressions can also be used augment the operator target.
Operator expressions can be used in the following format:
'{Operator}:{<Operator Expression>(...args)}'
More information on supported expressions and how to use them can be found in {@link Genai.Query.Operator.Expressions}.

Example query:
'What is an SDL Component? ext:any(pdf,txt) author:"John Smith"'
This will filter on files with a `pdf` OR `txt` fileType and an author of `John Smith`.

These base fields are available in all apps.
Developers can remix this type and {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}
to add their own custom operators and filterable fields.
name: Genai.Query.Operator.Types
